QuestInfo.name: Welcome to the Free Market!
QuestInfo.0: #p800018# in the #m80002000# is looking for an adventurer to help him. It seems the Free Market can be accessed through #m10001000# or #m10004000#.
QuestInfo.1: #p800018# in the #m80002000# asked me to deliver a letter to #p202# in #m10001000# to help revitalize the Free Market.

0.0: Is this your first time here at the Free Market? Well, then let me give you a quick introduction. The Free Market is a place where the adventurers of Maple World can freely buy and sell items. After all, you're always going to need various supplies for your adventures, right?
0.1: We've set up portals made of special magic stones in towns like #m10001000# and #m10004000#, making it easy to come here from all over Maple World and head back to your original town. The power of these magic stones is truly amazing.
0.2: So, creating the Free Market was a good start, but to really liven things up, we're definitely going to need some help from the surrounding towns. That brings me to my request... Could you possibly lend me a hand?

yes.0: Thank you! Then first, could you deliver this letter to #p202# in #m10001000#? We absolutely need the help of #m10001000# if we want this place to grow. I'm counting on you!

no.0: That's a shame. It would've been a great thing for you too if the Free Market became more active.

1.0: Do you have some business with me? Hmm? You're saying #p800018# in the #m80002000# asked you to deliver this letter to me? Let me see...

item.0: Do you have some business with me? Hmm? You're saying #p800018# in the #m80002000# asked you to deliver a letter to me? But where exactly is this letter you speak of?

lost.0: Oh, it looks like you lost my letter. Well, it happens. I'll write you a new one, so please try not to lose it this time.
